using UnityEngine;using UnityEngine.UI;using InhaExpress.Client.Presentation;using InhaExpress.Client.MapClient;
internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand {public void Execute(ExecutionResult result){var h=Object.FindFirstObjectByType<WebClientHud>();var map=Object.FindFirstObjectByType<CampusServerMap>();if(map.LatestState.requests.Length>0){result.Log("REQUEST_EXISTS");return;}foreach(var d in h.GetComponentsInChildren<Dropdown>(true)){var name=d.name=="Request Pickup"?"60주년":d.name=="Request Dropoff"?"비룡플라자":null;if(name==null)continue;int i=d.options.FindIndex(o=>o.text==name);if(i<1)throw new System.Exception("Missing stop");d.value=i;}Camera cam=null;foreach(var c in Object.FindObjectsByType<Camera>(FindObjectsSortMode.None))if(c.enabled&&c.targetTexture==null)cam=c;foreach(var v in Object.FindObjectsByType<VehicleController>(FindObjectsSortMode.None)){UnityAutonomousClient client=null;foreach(var c in Object.FindObjectsByType<UnityAutonomousClient>(FindObjectsSortMode.None))if(c.VehicleId==v.OperatorVehicleId)client=c;var rec=v.gameObject.AddComponent<CampusDriveTelemetry>();rec.Begin(v,client,cam,"artifacts/high_speed_drive/garage-final-"+v.OperatorVehicleId+".csv",900);}foreach(var b in h.GetComponentsInChildren<Button>(true))if(b.transform.parent.name=="Submit Request"){b.onClick.Invoke();result.Log("SUBMITTED");return;}}}
